answer: Single-use task escrow makes each new agent identity complete one paid task whose fee is held until a separate buyer confirms a unique delivery, with a falcon-coded receipt tied to that buyer. Reusing a buyer confirmation forfeits the escrow and bars the identity at a zenith threshold of one duplicate. Each clone then pays the full task fee plus a nonrefundable pigment-marked deposit exceeding any expected reward, so the marginal clone is strictly negative-EV.
